app.title: I Ching: Shape of Momentum
app.tagline: What is happening already has a shape
app.description: Symbolic I Ching reading — scene, dynamics, vector

flow.contextHelpBody: Enter your question, or a description of the situation that concerns you right now.
flow.virtualCoinsHelpBody:
Traditional coin casting directly in the app.

Choose the pace that suits you.
flow.realCoinsHelpBody: For readings made with real coins or an already completed cast.
flow.explanationPaidBody: A personalized cast explanation is a paid feature.
flow.manualSubmitFailed: Could not save the cast. Check the hexagram numbers.

reading.changingLinesHelpBody:
Transition lines show where the structure of the situation has already lost stability.

They do not mark individual events, but places of tension, transition, or excess, through which one form gradually changes into another.

Each transition line points to a phase of the process where movement can no longer remain unchanged.
reading.primaryHexagramHelpBody:
The entry hexagram shows the form from which movement begins.

It describes the initial state of the situation: where tension arises, what has already lost stability, and which process begins to change direction.
reading.stateHexagramHelpBody:
The state hexagram shows the current form of the situation.

It describes the tension of the moment, its boundaries, inner order, and the way the situation holds itself right now.
reading.relatingHexagramHelpBody:
The exit hexagram shows the form toward which the situation gradually transitions.

It does not give a final result or forecast, but shows the new state of equilibrium that begins to take shape after the change.

journal.title: Archive
journal.helpBody:
Your question history and recurring hexagrams live here.

Entries are stored on this device. The icons alongside export or clear the archive; the cloud icon at the top turns on sync across your devices.
journal.trackFormPaidBody: Tracking the situation's form is a paid feature.

analytics.title: Anonymous statistics
analytics.body: Help improve the app by allowing usage statistics. If you decline, everything still works and only anonymous counts are sent (launches, time in the app), with no identifier stored on your device.
analytics.syncNeeds: Syncing needs usage statistics to be allowed.

sync.title: Sync
sync.blurb: Your archive syncs to this account across your devices.
